name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-07-01, at wavelengths from 1.16 to 4.84 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
